exercise.name: Seated Barbell Overhead Extension
library_steps: Sit on a bench with back support, bar or EZ bar held overhead.
Lower it behind your head, elbows pointing up and close together.
Straighten your arms to press it back up.
exercise.one_line_summary: Seated on a bench with a short back pad, a bar held close-grip overhead; the upper arms stay up by the head while the elbows bend ~130 deg and the bar drops behind the head. Triceps does the work, the long head on a stretch.

setup.target: Seated upright, back on the pad, feet flat.
Close, palms facing forward and up.

muscles.emg: Elbow extensor; overhead elbow extension grew the long head 1.5x more than at the side (MAEO).

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Upper arms open out to the sides.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Less long-head stretch and shoulder strain.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci.
sources.what_it_gave: 12 weeks of elbow extensions (90-0 deg) overhead vs arm at the side: overhead grew the long head 1.5x more (+28.5 % vs +19.6 %) and the whole triceps 1.4x more.

sources.citation: Tiwana MS, Sinkler MA, Bordoni B. 2023. Anatomy, Shoulder and Upper Limb, Triceps Muscle. StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf).
sources.what_it_gave: Triceps brachii: three heads on the back of the upper arm, extends the elbow; the long head starts on the shoulder blade.

clip_check.check: Arms straight overhead at the start
Bar behind the head at the end
